question: Which forms of worship are included within this universally effective practice?
premises: The practice may be Śākta in form.
The practice may be Vaiṣṇava or Śaiva.
Any other form of worship is likewise included.
inference: All forms of worship, regardless of tradition, fall under this effective practice.
plain_english: Whether the worship is Śākta, Vaiṣṇava, Śaiva, or of any other kind, the same holds true.
